The LLM extraction mode automatically falls back to deterministic parsing if an error occurs or if the API key is missing. This modular pipeline converts financial context documents in PDF, CSV, or TXT formats into auto-filled PDF research reports.

The system is built using Python 3.11, FastAPI, Uvicorn, Jinja2, ReportLab, matplotlib, and pdfplumber. It separates visual styling from data extraction logic, meaning the data model remains unchanged even when customizing the visual output of the reports.

Users can achieve a pixel-perfect match to a specific Geojit PDF by placing the target file in the samples folder and updating the theme and geometry settings. Data missing from the source document is rendered as 'NA' in the final report and noted in the API response.

This project is a "reconstructed research template for a take-home exercise" and is not affiliated with or produced by Geojit Financial Services Ltd. The reports generated by this application do not constitute investment advice.

claims.text: The web application converts financial context documents in PDF, CSV, or TXT formats into auto-filled PDF research reports.
The report layout is designed to mirror the structure of Geojit-style equity research notes.
The system offers two extraction modes: a deterministic rule-based parser and an optional LLM-based path using Claude.
The LLM extraction mode automatically falls back to deterministic parsing if an error occurs or if the API key is missing.
The application is built using Python 3.11, FastAPI, Uvicorn, Jinja2, ReportLab, matplotlib, and pdfplumber.
Data missing from the source document is rendered as 'NA' in the final report and noted in the API response.
The application supports the generation of reports from CSV and TXT files as demonstrated by the bundled examples.
The Geojit-style report generator is organized into a directory structure containing modules for FastAPI routing, configuration, data modeling, extraction, and PDF generation.
Users can achieve a pixel-perfect match to a specific Geojit PDF by placing the target file in the samples folder and updating the theme and geometry settings within the configuration file.
Modifying the section order and spacing of the generated report is handled through the PDF builder module.
The data model and extraction logic remain unchanged even when customizing the visual output of the reports.
This project is a reconstructed template for a take-home exercise and is not affiliated with or produced by Geojit Financial Services Ltd.
The reports generated by this application do not constitute investment advice.
